publisher: Co*Tive Collector local governed data hub
ownership: Derived review evidence and human labels bounded by every contributing source policy
review_status: Local review only; no record-level packet or label is approved for public export.
allowed_use: aggregate quality analysis after privacy review
prohibited_use: silent mutation of source entities or resolution decisions
treating a precision pass as source-policy permission
claiming recall or national completeness from this sample
attribution: Retain the exact registry and resolution dependency hashes, sampling seed, reviewer identity, time, and evidence note.
retention: Retain immutable sample releases and submitted label evidence locally; corrections supersede prior labels without deleting history.
redistribution: Record-level packets and labels are local-review-only. Aggregate metrics require separate privacy and contributing-source policy review.
personal_data_note: Review packets can contain source-reported home-based addresses, names, identifiers, and linkage evidence.
